blocks.STYLE_PAPER: Editorial children's picture-book illustration in gouache and soft coloured pencil on warm off-white cotton paper. Visible paper tooth, dry-brush edges and fine pencil hatching; matte and hand-made, no digital gloss. Soft natural daylight from a window on the left, gentle lilac-grey shadows. Restrained palette: warm cream paper, deep plum-violet, muted ochre gold, dusty rose, pale oak wood, soft warm grey. Quiet, intimate, emotionally honest and understated, like a modern European picture book that adults linger over. Not cartoon, not anime, not 3D, not photographic, no airbrushed skin, no sparkles, no fantasy glow.
blocks.STYLE_NIGHT: Editorial children's picture-book illustration in gouache on dark toned paper. A deep ink-violet night palette (near-black violet, plum, muted indigo) with a single warm light source: a small paper lamp standing on the floor that casts a soft golden pool of light. Visible brush texture and paper tooth; matte and hand-made, no digital gloss, no neon, no sparkles, no stars. Quiet, intimate, emotionally honest and understated, like a modern European picture book that adults linger over. Not cartoon, not anime, not 3D, not photographic, no airbrushed skin.

blocks.SCENE_COVER: Scene: the boy sits on the floorboards of a quiet bedroom with his knees pulled up, beside a small empty wooden bassinet made up with a folded cream blanket. His face is in clear three-quarter view toward the viewer.

blocks.SCENE_2: Scene: the boy and his mother sit side by side on the floor of a quiet bedroom. He leans his head against her shoulder and she rests her arm around his shoulders, her head tilted toward his and turned away from the viewer. Beside them on the floor lies a small neat stack of folded tiny baby clothes with a little knitted baby hat on top: the new baby is coming. The boy's face is in clear three-quarter view: thoughtful and a little unsure, but held and calmer.
blocks.SCENE_3: Scene: the same small wooden baby bed from the reference now holds a sleeping newborn swaddled in a cream blanket (only the swaddled bundle and a tiny sleeping face in profile are visible). The boy stands beside it on tiptoe with his chin resting on the bed's edge, looking at the baby with a mixed expression: tender and curious, and also a little wistful. Behind his back, his other hand still holds the worn grey plush rabbit by one ear.
blocks.SCENE_4: Scene: a wide, quiet view from behind. The boy and his mother walk away from the viewer, hand in hand, along a simple path through a sparse park drawn with a few pencil trees and pale grass; just the two of them, no baby, no pram. His small hand is in hers; he looks up at her. Their backs are to the viewer. Calm, private, unhurried.
blocks.SCENE_5: Scene: the boy is curled up in his mother's lap in a soft armchair, wrapped in a cream knitted baby blanket that is too small for him, like a much younger child. Her arms hold him close; her head is bowed over him so her face is hidden by her hair and out of view. The boy's eyes are half closed and his face is peaceful and safe. The worn grey plush rabbit is tucked under his chin.
blocks.SCENE_6: Scene: a close view over the boy's shoulder as he sits on the floor with a large square picture book open on his lap. The open pages show a painted illustration, in the same style, of this same boy in his plum-violet sweater gently holding a newborn's tiny hand beside a small wooden baby bed. The book's pages contain illustration only, with no writing at all. His face is partly visible in three-quarter profile: absorbed, recognising himself, a small beginning of a smile.
blocks.SCENE_7: Scene: the boy sits upright and proud on the floor next to the small wooden baby bed where the swaddled newborn sleeps, reading aloud from a large square softcover picture book held open in both hands, tilted toward the baby. A thin ochre-gold ribbon bookmark hangs from the book. His face is in clear three-quarter view: confident, gentle, a quiet smile. The grey plush rabbit sits beside him on the floor.
